name: coverage-spine-validation
body: The spine-scoped coverage gate. `coverage_check` (src/plan_cmd.rs:1097) is rewritten to walk the spine from each requirement a `PlanPhase` `Satisfies` (Requirement → Drives → Domain → RealisedBy → Solution → SpecImplementedBy) and require every reached solution node's `implemented-by` FQN to be touched by at least one plan task, plus every solution node ADDED ON THIS BRANCH (default-branch delta). Pre-existing solution nodes unreachable from a satisfied requirement are exempt, so prior projects' implemented code no longer forces fake `modifies` tasks. `plan_verify_at` (src/plan_cmd.rs:947) is the caller that must supply the satisfied-requirement set and the branch delta; it may compare against `apg.git.origin_default_branch` (src/git.rs:340) to compute the delta, but does not modify that function.
